property_summary: If C.transfer returns (i.e., does not revert) then it always returns true and makes no changes observable to address(c).balance (i.e., it does not transfer Ether out of c).
If transfer returns (does not revert) then it returns true.
If transfer does not revert, it returns true and every internal call to caddress succeeded (i.e., not reverted) — equivalently: non-reverting transfer returns true.
If C.transfer returns (does not revert) then it returns true and does not change address(this).balance (the test contract's balance) as a result of the call.
If transfer returns (does not revert) then it returns true and does not change address(c).balance.
